The current low-level goals (LLGs) cover the essential aspects of hospital entity management, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time monitoring. Each LLG is document-supported and describes a distinct system interaction or effect. There are no unsupported or misleading children, and all essential capabilities of the parent goal are present and non-redundant.

The 'Register Hospital in System' (llg_001) documents the Administrator registering a new hospital entity with required metadata.

The 'Configure Hospital Settings' (llg_002) describes the Administrator configuring hospital-specific settings such as contact info, operating hours, and departmental structure.

The 'Update Hospital Information' (llg_003) explains how the Administrator modifies existing hospital metadata like address, contact details, or operational status.

The 'Delete Hospital from System' (llg_004) outlines the process of removing a hospital entity from the system, including associated metadata and configurations.

The 'Monitor Hospital Status' (llg_005) specifies that the Administrator views real-time operational status, including active/inactive status, resource availability, and performance metrics.

All these LLGs are relevant to the parent goal of Centralizing Hospital Administration. They cover the entire lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system without any redundancy or omission.
